quest.title: Warehousing Business
quest.description: Najat from Aaru Village seems to be having some trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Najat
dialogues.text: Ugh, these Red Vultures! They just won't leave, will they?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Excuse me, what happened?

dialogues.speaker: Najat
dialogues.text: Are you... the Traveler? I've heard about you from Ebeid.

dialogues.speaker: Najat
dialogues.text: Hehe, we don't usually see many travelers around, so I wasn't expecting you.

dialogues.speaker: Najat
dialogues.text: Oh, have you met Habachi? The lad's always so strict — makes him seem unapproachable at times. Please don't feel offended though.

dialogues.speaker: Najat
dialogues.text: You see, we've got all sorts of stuff stored here, not just food but also clothes, weapons, and even Mora and goods...

dialogues.speaker: Najat
dialogues.text: There aren't many young people in this place, and they need to manage all kinds of things, from protecting the village to the daily affairs of villagers. As a result, Habachi has been the only person on the warehouse-guarding duty.

dialogues.speaker: Najat
dialogues.text: I can't help him much except for keeping accounts and tallying goods.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's with the Red Vultures?

dialogues.speaker: Najat
dialogues.text: *sigh* Don't get me started. We just received a batch of jerky in the warehouse...

dialogues.speaker: Najat
dialogues.text: I guess it's the scent or something that has attracted these birds. Anyway, they started lurking on the hill near the warehouse from time to time.

dialogues.speaker: Najat
dialogues.text: They can't have their way with the jerky locked in the warehouse, but whoever eats in front of them becomes an easy target instead.

dialogues.speaker: Najat
dialogues.text: Our guards are too busy to come and get rid of them, nor is Habachi available...

dialogues.speaker: Najat
dialogues.text: Traveler, if you have time, could you deal with them for us?

response.speaker: Najat
response.text: Thank you so much. Those vultures are fierce. You might want to keep your distance. I'd suggest using a bow and arrow to get rid of them. It's safer.

response.speaker: Najat
response.text: Yes, lots of things, actually — the goods we're transporting, the meat we're drying, and also Habachi's lunchboxes...

response.speaker: Najat
response.text: Every time Habachi's having lunch while on duty, the vultures always come snatch his meat away when he's not watching.

response.speaker: Najat
response.text: The poor lad can't leave his post to chase after them, so he has to make do with what's left...

response.speaker: Najat
response.text: So, please get rid of the vultures for us.

dialogues.speaker: Najat
dialogues.text: So, please get rid of the vultures for us.

dialogues.speaker: Najat
dialogues.text: How did it go? Did you take care of them?

response.speaker: Najat
response.text: Thank you so much! Habachi can finally have a peaceful lunch.

response.speaker: Najat
response.text: Here, this is for you.

response.speaker: Najat
response.text: Um... What else will arrive today?

choices.text: You won't see them for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Najat
dialogues.text: *sigh* Habachi should really allow himself some rest...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Najat
dialogues.text: Traveler, perfect timing! Could you help me with something?

dialogues.speaker: Najat
dialogues.text: We just got some dried foods from outside the village. Habachi was about to deliver them here.

dialogues.speaker: Najat
dialogues.text: But a group of Red Vultures was attracted by the smell and came whooshing down.

dialogues.speaker: Najat
dialogues.text: Although the guards managed to drive them away quickly, they had scattered the food everywhere.

dialogues.speaker: Najat
dialogues.text: Some people have left to warn other delivery teams, and Habachi's busy retrieving what is still edible. Traveler, could you help us?

response.speaker: Najat
response.text: Thank you so much. My apologies, I've got another batch of goods coming in, so I can't go myself.

response.speaker: Najat
response.text: *sigh* I asked him to take a break, but he wouldn't listen. He said he'd go over the goods in the warehouse once he was done putting the scattered food back. He's overworking himself.

response.speaker: Najat
response.text: The goods should be near the White Lift. Please bring them to me, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Najat
dialogues.text: The goods should be near the White Lift. Please bring them to me, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Najat
dialogues.text: Traveler, did you get the goods?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, got them right here.

dialogues.speaker: Najat
dialogues.text: Great! Please leave them there. Thank you so much.

dialogues.speaker: Najat
dialogues.text: Habachi is tallying some other stuff in the warehouse. I'll take care of the food here.

dialogues.speaker: Najat
dialogues.text: *sigh* Fingers crossed that we didn't lose too much food...

dialogues.speaker: Najat
dialogues.text: Ah, Traveler, thank goodness you've come! Please go help Habachi!

response.speaker: Najat
response.text: *sigh* A group of Treasure Hoarders suddenly showed up outside the village and stopped one of our delivery teams. We've summoned every guard available to help.

response.speaker: Najat
response.text: But Habachi said that was not enough, so he also grabbed a weapon to join the guards.

response.speaker: Najat
response.text: I heard there are too many Treasure Hoarders this time. Habachi can't handle them on his own.

response.speaker: Najat
response.text: Traveler, I've marked the location on the map. Please help him.

response.speaker: Najat
response.text: I'm counting on you. Hope nothing happens to Habachi.

response.speaker: Najat
response.text: He can handle a thug or two alright.

response.speaker: Najat
response.text: But it's a whole group of ambushing Treasure Hoarders we're talking about. Had it not been for the fast runner in the delivery team, no one would've known what happened.

response.speaker: Najat
response.text: *sigh* How I wish Ms. Candace were around — none of the Treasure Hoarders would dare to lift a finger.

response.speaker: Najat
response.text: They must've been waiting for her departure.

response.speaker: Najat
response.text: Traveler, please help Habachi.

dialogues.speaker: Najat
dialogues.text: Traveler, please help Habachi. I... I'll see if I can get other people to help.

dialogues.speaker: Habachi
dialogues.text: Huff... Thank you so much, Traveler. We wouldn't be able to keep the goods without you.

response.speaker: Habachi
response.text: Haha, I'm flattered. But I wouldn't be able to handle all of them.

response.speaker: Habachi
response.text: *sigh* I wish I were stronger. If it were Candace, all of these Treasure Hoarders would be lying on the ground now.

response.speaker: Habachi
response.text: My bad, there's no time for this. I've got to send the goods back to the village.

response.speaker: Habachi
response.text: Traveler, it's not safe around here. You should return as quickly as possible.

response.speaker: Habachi
response.text: But when I think about it, the Treasure Hoarders sure keep their ears on the ground...

response.speaker: Habachi
response.text: There were other guards with me, but they went elsewhere to look for the goods.
